# Breadcrumb

```tsx
import { Breadcrumb, BreadcrumbList, BreadcrumbItem, BreadcrumbLink, BreadcrumbPage, BreadcrumbSeparator } from "@lucasdost/design-system"
```

Shows the path to the current resource in a hierarchy. Mirrors the Figma Breadcrumbs: 2 to 6 items, with Default / Hover / Disabled links and the Active page.

## Example

From the Storybook story; names like `args` or `label` are the story controls.

```tsx
<Breadcrumb {...args}>
  <BreadcrumbList>
    {Array.from({ length: items - 1 }, (_, index) => (
      <React.Fragment key={index}>
        <BreadcrumbItem>
          <BreadcrumbLink
            href="#"
            disabled={disableFirstLink && index === 0}
          >
            Página {index + 1}
          </BreadcrumbLink>
        </BreadcrumbItem>
        <BreadcrumbSeparator />
      </React.Fragment>
    ))}
    <BreadcrumbItem>
      <BreadcrumbPage>{currentPage}</BreadcrumbPage>
    </BreadcrumbItem>
  </BreadcrumbList>
</Breadcrumb>
```

## Figma notes

Mirrors the Figma Breadcrumbs component. Its "Property 1" (2–6 items) is just how many items you compose; each item follows .Breadcrumbs Item: Default / Hover / Disabled for links and Active for the current page.

## Props

Documented props only; every component also accepts the props of the element or Base UI part it renders (`className`, events, ARIA…).

`BreadcrumbLink`:

| Prop | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `disabled?` | `boolean` | Figma State=Disabled. |

## Rules

- Import `Breadcrumb` from `@lucasdost/design-system`. Do not rebuild it with plain HTML and Tailwind classes.
- Style it through its props and variants first. Use `className` only for layout (margin, width, grid placement), never to change its colors, typography or radius.
- Colors come from the S0L tokens; see [color](../foundations/color.md).
